# SDK-CLIENTS-JAVA-GO: Java + Go ## Intent D-1 named `/rust /python /typescript /java /go`. Rust + Python + TypeScript are delivered; **Java and Go are missing**, so the two remaining enterprise-native stacks cannot consume the frozen catalog or verify the trail. Add independent re-implementations (Strategy A). ## Dependencies - #26/#27 (Rust + TS clients) + the Python verifier — MERGED. - SDK-SCHEMAS-PUBLISH / #34 — consume the shared corpus; do not re-vendor. ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) - **Delivered:** `rust/rigorix-verifier` + `rust/rigorix-client`; `python/rigorix_verifier`; `typescript/` (verifier) + `typescript-client/`. - **NOT delivered:** `java/`, `go/` (no directories). - **Reference behaviour (must match byte-exact):** - canonical bytes = compact JSON, `signature`/`sig` nulled, struct field order - HMAC-SHA256 over canonical bytes (fixture key `fixture-hmac-key-2026`) - chain: `prev_hash = SHA-256(prev canonical w/ signature nulled)`, genesis `0` - anchor: Ed25519 over `signing_bytes` (`sig` nulled) - **Parity corpus:** `schemas/fixtures/**` (`envelope/`, `integrity/`, `events/`) incl. `envelope-anchored-signed.json` (the `anchor_head` position test). ## Target State - `java/` — typed catalog client + verifier (HMAC + chain + Ed25519 + schema). - `go/` — the same surface. - Both: protocol-only (**no** `rigorix-engine` dep), consume the shared corpus/contract, register-able artifacts (Maven Central / Go module), passing the **same** fixtures. ## In Scope - Java + Go HMAC/canonical/chain/Ed25519 verifiers, byte-exact on the fixtures. - Java + Go clients binding every frozen catalog method (drift test vs `catalog.json`). - Per-language CI jobs. - Register-able artifact config (`pom.xml`/Gradle, `go.mod`) + docs. ## Out of Scope - Rust/Python/TS (done); PyPI/npm (#33). ## Affected Layers - **java** — `java/**` (create) - **go** — `go/**` (create) - **ci** — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` ## Canonical References - `docs/strategy-freeze-2026-09-06.md` (D-1 layout, D-2 Strategy A) - `rust/rigorix-verifier` (canonical reference), `python/rigorix_verifier`, `typescript/src` - corpus: `schemas/fixtures/**`; contract: `schemas/api/catalog.json` ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | Java + Go verifiers byte-exact on the committed fixtures (HMAC + chain + Ed25519) | CI | | 2 | Client binds every frozen catalog method (drift test) | drift test | | 3 | Protocol-only; register-able artifacts | review | | 4 | Per-language CI green | CI | ## Implementation Steps 1. Derive the canonical field order from `schemas/envelope.json` (as Python/TS do). 2. Implement HMAC + canonical + chain + Ed25519 verification per language. 3. Implement the catalog client (bind every method; drift test vs `catalog.json`). 4. Configure register-able artifacts + per-language CI. ## Notes / Gotchas - Independent re-implementations are the point (Strategy A) — check against the shared fixtures; do **not** shell out to Rust. - Canonical field order is the hard part — **derive it from the schema**, never from memory. - Preserve skip-when-absent semantics (a field enters signed bytes only when present).
title: SDK-CLIENTS-JAVA-GO: Java + Go clients & verifiers (D-1 language dirs)

Guardian contract (machine-readable front matter — parsed by the Guardian pipeline) ```yaml guardian_issue: id: "SDK-CRATES-0.2.0" title: "Republish rigorix-schemas + rigorix-verifier 0.2.0 (published 0.1.0 predates anchor_head)" epic: "SDK distribution (D-1 / D-2)" status: planned priority: high created_at: "2026-09-25T00:00:00Z" dependencies: - name: "rigorix-sdk #31/#32 (anchor_head declared) — MERGED (4efbc32)" type: internal - name: "OSS-ANCHOR-WIRE-E2E (#912) / ENT-ANCHOR-ENDPOINT (#215)" type: cross-repo validators: [ci, tests, architecture, canonical] pipeline_steps: [implement, validate, create-mr, merge, publish] ```
# SDK-CRATES-0.2.0: republish the SDK crates ## Intent `rigorix-schemas` 0.1.0 + `rigorix-verifier` 0.1.0 were published **before** #31/#32 added the Phase C `anchor_head`. The crates.io verifier therefore **cannot verify an anchored envelope** — wrong for its core purpose. Republish as 0.2.0, then bump the consumers. ## Dependencies - **#31/#32** (`anchor_head` declared) — MERGED `4efbc32`. - **#912** / **#215** — must run against an `anchor_head`-aware verifier. ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) - `rust/Cargo.toml` → `[workspace.package] version = "0.1.0"` (both crates use `version.workspace = true`). - `rust/rigorix-verifier/Cargo.toml` → `rigorix-schemas = { version = "0.1.0", path = "../rigorix-schemas" }`. - `rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs:149` → `pub anchor_head: Option` (serde-defaulted; after `history_policy`, before `approval_events`). Position test `lib.rs:1007` (`anchored_envelope_binds_anchor_head_at_engine_position`). - Fixture proving it: `schemas/fixtures/envelope/envelope-anchored-signed.json`. - Published on crates.io: `rigorix-schemas` **0.1.0**, `rigorix-verifier` **0.1.0** (STALE). - Consumers (**0.x: `^0.1` does NOT match `0.2` → must bump**): - `rigorix-oss/server/Cargo.toml:41` → `rigorix-verifier = "0.1.0"` - `rigorix-enterprise/core/Cargo.toml:54` → `rigorix-verifier = "0.1"` - CI gates exist (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): `cargo package -p rigorix-schemas` (l.55); Python/TS pack→install→smoke jobs. ## Target State - `rust/Cargo.toml` workspace version → `0.2.0`; verifier's schemas dep → `0.2.0`. - Publish `rigorix-schemas` 0.2.0 **first**, then `rigorix-verifier` 0.2.0. - Tag the SDK release; note in `docs/contract-sync-2026-09-06.md`. - Bump the two consumers to 0.2; green their CI. ## In Scope - Bump workspace version 0.1.0 → 0.2.0 (both crates) + the verifier's schemas dep. - Prove the **packed** 0.2.0 carries `anchor_head`: `cargo package` → unpack → verify `envelope-anchored-signed.json` with `RIGORIX_SDK_SCHEMAS` **unset**. - Publish `rigorix-schemas` 0.2.0 then `rigorix-verifier` 0.2.0. - Tag; contract-sync note; crate READMEs if they cite a version. - Bump `rigorix-oss/server/Cargo.toml:41` + `rigorix-enterprise/core/Cargo.toml:54` to 0.2; run their CI. ## Out of Scope - New contract changes; PyPI/npm (`SDK-PUBLISH-PY-TS` #33). ## Affected Layers - **rust** — `rust/Cargo.toml` (workspace version), `rust/rigorix-verifier/Cargo.toml` (schemas dep) - **docs** — `docs/contract-sync-2026-09-06.md` - **cross-repo** — `rigorix-oss/server/Cargo.toml`, `rigorix-enterprise/core/Cargo.toml` ## Canonical References - `rust/rigorix-schemas` (`build.rs` embeds `schemas/`), `rust/rigorix-verifier/src/lib.rs:149,1007` - fixture: `schemas/fixtures/envelope/envelope-anchored-signed.json` - CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`cargo package` l.55; Python/TS pack-smoke) - precedent: the 0.1.0 publish + the #30 pack→install→smoke gates ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | 0.2.0 `rigorix-schemas` embeds `envelope.json` WITH `anchor_head` (embedded == on-disk) | unit | | 2 | Packed 0.2.0 `rigorix-verifier` verifies `envelope-anchored-signed.json` byte-exact with **no** env override | clean-project smoke | | 3 | Both published + tagged | release | | 4 | OSS + enterprise dev-deps bumped to 0.2; their CI green | their CI | | 5 | CI green | CI | ## Implementation Steps 1. Bump `rust/Cargo.toml` workspace version + the verifier's schemas dep → `0.2.0`. 2. `cargo package -p rigorix-schemas`; unpack; assert the embedded corpus has `anchor_head`; verify the anchored fixture. 3. `cargo publish -p rigorix-schemas` → then `cargo publish -p rigorix-verifier`. 4. Tag + contract-sync note. 5. Bump the two consumers; run their CI. ## Notes / Gotchas - Publish **schemas first** — the verifier's dep is exact-versioned. - **0.x semver cascade**: the consumer bumps are mandatory and easy to forget — this is a multi-repo release. - Do **not** yank 0.1.0 (valid for catalog-only use); document that 0.2.0 is required for anchored verification. - Verify from a **clean** scratch project (never the workspace path).
title: SDK-CRATES-0.2.0: republish `rigorix-schemas` + `rigorix-verifier` (0.1.0 predates `anchor_head`)

Guardian contract (machine-readable front matter — parsed by the Guardian pipeline) ```yaml guardian_issue: id: "SDK-PUBLISH-PY-TS" title: "Publish the Python + TypeScript verifiers/clients to PyPI + npm" epic: "SDK distribution (D-1 / D-2)" status: planned priority: medium created_at: "2026-09-25T00:00:00Z" dependencies: - name: "SDK #30 (pack->install->smoke gates) + Python/TS verifiers + TS client — MERGED" type: internal validators: [ci, tests, operations] pipeline_steps: [implement, validate, create-mr, merge, publish] ```
# SDK-PUBLISH-PY-TS: publish to PyPI + npm ## Intent The Python and TypeScript artifacts build and pass **pack-smoke** in CI but are **never published**, so external consumers cannot install them. Publish `rigorix-verifier` (PyPI + npm), `rigorix-schemas` (PyPI, if shipped), and `rigorix-client` (npm), and wire a tag-triggered release job. ## Dependencies - SDK #30 (pack→install→smoke gates) + the Python/TS verifiers + TS client — MERGED. Only registry publication remains. ## Current State (ground truth — read before changing anything) - `python/pyproject.toml` → `name = "rigorix-verifier"`, `version = "0.1.0"`. - `typescript/package.json` → `name = "rigorix-verifier"`, `version = "0.1.0"`. - `typescript-client/package.json` → `name = "rigorix-client"`, `version = "0.1.0"`. - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` builds + packs + smoke-installs wheels/sdist + the npm tarball with `RIGORIX_SDK_SCHEMAS` **unset** (`python/scripts/pack_smoke.py`, `typescript/scripts/pack-smoke.mjs`). - **No publish step** to PyPI/npm exists; no registry tokens configured. ## Target State Release jobs publish the packed artifacts to PyPI (Trusted Publishing or `PYPI_TOKEN`) and npm (`NPM_TOKEN`), at the same version as the content, triggered on the SDK release tag. After publish, a clean `pip install rigorix-verifier` / `npm i rigorix-verifier rigorix-client` must verify the anchored fixture with no env override. ## In Scope - **Version decision (recommended):** fold into the **0.2.0** republish (#34) so all languages share one version. - Publish `rigorix-verifier` → PyPI (wheel + sdist) + npm; `rigorix-client` → npm. - Add a tag-triggered publish job (Trusted Publishing / `*_TOKEN` secrets). - Post-publish smoke: install from the registry in a clean env; verify `envelope-anchored-signed.json` with no `RIGORIX_SDK_SCHEMAS`. - Document install snippets in the READMEs. ## Out of Scope - Rust crates.io (#34); Java/Go (#35). ## Affected Layers - **packaging** — `python/pyproject.toml`, `typescript/package.json`, `typescript-client/package.json` (version alignment) - **ci** — `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (publish jobs) - **docs** — READMEs (install) ## Canonical References - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (python pack-smoke l.98-112; ts pack-smoke l.140-156; ts-client l.173-182) - `python/scripts/pack_smoke.py`, `typescript/scripts/pack-smoke.mjs`, `python/rigorix_verifier/**`, `typescript/src/**` ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | All three artifacts published at one aligned version | registry | | 2 | Publish is tag-triggered + reproducible (CI job) | CI | | 3 | Clean install from the registry verifies the anchored fixture with no env override | smoke | | 4 | Install docs added | review | | 5 | CI green | CI | ## Implementation Steps 1. Align versions (fold into 0.2.0 if #34 lands first). 2. Configure PyPI (Trusted Publishing preferred) + npm automation token. 3. Add the tag-triggered publish job. 4. Run the post-publish smoke (existing pack-smoke scripts, registry source). 5. Add install snippets to the READMEs. ## Notes / Gotchas - Prefer PyPI **Trusted Publishing** (OIDC) over a long-lived token; npm automation token with 2FA bypass for CI. - The packed artifact must contain the **real corpus** (npm/setuptools do **not** dereference the symlink — that is why `bundle-schemas.mjs` / `bundle_schemas.py` exist). Reuse the existing pack-smoke scripts verbatim as the post-publish gate.
title: SDK-PUBLISH-PY-TS: publish the Python + TypeScript verifiers to PyPI + npm
